user_first_visits.name: user_first_visits
user_first_visits.body_sql:
SELECT 
  visitorId AS user_id, 
  MIN(date) AS first_visit_date, 
  MIN(totals.timeOnSite) AS first_visit_duration
FROM `bigquery-public-data.google_analytics_sample.ga_sessions_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '20160801' AND '20170801'
GROUP BY visitorId
user_first_visits.description: aggregates all visits per user to extract the earliest visit date and its corresponding duration

all_participants.name: all_participants
all_participants.description: The complete cohort of participants in the dataset.

quinapril_users.name: quinapril_users
quinapril_users.body_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT dp.participant_id
FROM `all_participants` dp
JOIN `bigquery-public-data.cms_synthetic_patient_data_omop.drug_exposure` de
  ON dp.participant_id = de.person_id
quinapril_users.description: Participants linked to medication records where the drug identifier matches the specified target.

complaint_type_correlations.name: complaint_type_correlations
complaint_type_correlations.body_sql:
WITH daily_counts AS (
  SELECT
    complaint_type,
    DATE(created_date) AS req_date,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
daily_proportions AS (
  SELECT
    complaint_type,
    req_date,
    cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY complaint_type) AS daily_proportion
  FROM daily_counts
),
daily_weather AS (
  SELECT
    DATE(CONCAT(year, '-', mo, '-', da)) AS weather_date,
    AVG(CAST(wdsp AS FLOAT64)) AS avg_wind_speed
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.noaa_gsod.gsod*`
  WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1929' AND '2024'
  GROUP BY 1
),
valid_types AS (
  SELECT complaint_type
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.311_service_requests`
  GROUP BY complaint_type
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 3000
)
SELECT
  dp.complaint_type,
  CORR(dp.daily_proportion, dw.avg_wind_speed) AS pearson_correlation_coefficient
FROM daily_proportions dp
JOIN daily_weather dw ON dp.req_date = dw.weather_date
JOIN valid_types vt ON dp.complaint_type = vt.complaint_type
GROUP BY dp.complaint_type
complaint_type_correlations.description: Pearson correlation coefficient between daily proportion and wind speed for each complaint type, filtered to types with over 3000 total requests

valid_observations.name: valid_observations
valid_observations.body_sql:
SELECT
  id AS observation_id,
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date) AS year,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'PRCP' THEN value END) AS precipitation,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMIN' THEN value END) AS min_temperature,
  MAX(CASE WHEN element = 'TMAX' THEN value END) AS max_temperature
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1763' AND '2024'
  AND element IN ('PRCP', 'TMIN', 'TMAX')
  AND mflag IS NOT NULL
  AND value IS NOT NULL
  AND EXTRACT(DAYOFYEAR FROM date) >= 351
GROUP BY id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)
valid_observations.description: Filters raw weather records to retain only validated, non-null entries that match the specified station identifier, year range, and the final 15-day window of each year.

daily_weather_classification.name: daily_weather_classification
daily_weather_classification.body_sql:
SELECT
  date,
  SUM(value) / 10.0 AS normalized_precipitation,
  CASE WHEN SUM(value) > 0 THEN 'rainy' ELSE 'non-rainy' END AS rainy_status
FROM `bigquery-public-data.ghcn_d.ghcnd_*`
WHERE _TABLE_SUFFIX BETWEEN '1763' AND '2024'
  AND element = 'PR'
GROUP BY date
daily_weather_classification.description: Aggregates raw precipitation measurements from the nearest valid GHCN station within 50km of the target coordinates into daily totals, normalizes the value by dividing by 10, and classifies each day as rainy or non-rainy based on the threshold.

combined_daily_metrics.name: combined_daily_metrics
combined_daily_metrics.body_sql:
SELECT
  dw.rainy_status,
  AVG(dtc.daily_trips) AS average_daily_trips
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE(starttime) AS trip_date,
    COUNT(*) AS daily_trips
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  GROUP BY DATE(starttime)
) dtc
JOIN daily_weather_classification dw
  ON dtc.trip_date = dw.date
GROUP BY dw.rainy_status
combined_daily_metrics.description: Joins daily bike trip counts with the weather classification relation, filters for the target year, and computes the average daily trip count grouped by rainy and non-rainy status.

same_station_trips_group_flagged.name: same_station_trips_group_flagged
same_station_trips_group_flagged.body_sql:
WITH same_station_trips AS (
  SELECT
    MD5(CAST(starttime AS STRING) || CAST(bikeid AS STRING)) AS trip_id,
    start_station_id AS station_id,
    starttime
  FROM `bigquery-public-data.new_york.citibike_trips`
  WHERE start_station_id = end_station_id
)
SELECT
  trip_id,
  station_id,
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM same_station_trips t2
    WHERE t2.station_id = same_station_trips.station_id
      AND t2.trip_id != same_station_trips.trip_id
      AND ABS(TIMESTAMP_DIFF(same_station_trips.starttime, t2.starttime, SECOND)) <= 120
  ) AS is_group_ride
FROM same_station_trips
same_station_trips_group_flagged.description: trips that start and end at the same station, with a boolean flag indicating whether at least one other trip starts/ends at the same station within a 2-minute departure window
